title: The Wellness Reset: A Two-Night Peninsula Weekend
dek: Thermal pools, a coastal walk, vineyard meals and two nights in the same place. For people whose weekend brief is simply to slow down.

bookingChecklist.item: Lunch reservations and in-house dinner service

stops.note: Begin with lunch at Merricks General. Confirm the kitchen's service times before planning your arrival.
Check in after lunch and leave time for the garden. Arrange dinner with the property rather than assuming a late meal is available.
Book a morning session. Move through the circuit properly instead of ticking pools off a list.
Lunch on the vineyard terrace if the weather allows. Keep it lighter than a degustation.
An optional coastal stop between lunch and dinner. Check park access and weather before deciding to make the drive.
Second night at the same property. Skip dinner out and let the in-house kitchen deliver the softer version.
On the way home, stop at the regional gallery for a quiet hour before the drive back.

editorNote: Use the same stay for both nights and make the thermal session the one fixed point of Saturday. Lunch at Merricks starts the trip; the gallery finishes it. The Cape Schanck stop is optional if you would rather return to the property after lunch. Check each booking's cancellation terms before paying, especially if keeping the weekend flexible matters to you.
